predictions.prediction_text: The longer-term SPX/yields correlation will remain or flip sharply positive, supporting equities through a growth-focused interpretation of macro prints.
predictions.expected_result: SPX prices rise while long-term yields do not spike; correlation metric moves into and stays in positive territory over weeks to months

predictions.prediction_text: Bessent-style long-end support measures will stabilize long-term Treasury yields and reduce tail risk in yield swings.
predictions.expected_result: Intraday and interday realized volatility of 10-year yields falls and extreme yield moves (> X basis points per day) become less frequent in the following weeks

predictions.prediction_text: Pro-cyclical systematic flows enabled by reduced rates tail risk will push markets higher via a reflexive wealth-effect loop (technicals→news→liquidity→momentum).
predictions.expected_result: SPX posts sustained upward momentum with higher highs over the subsequent months and reduced drawdowns during macro data releases

predictions.prediction_text: Liquidity-support buybacks and reserve-management T-bill purchases will act as a form of hidden QE, loosening financial conditions and prioritizing growth financing over fighting inflation.
predictions.expected_result: Term premium compresses and long-end yields decline or stabilize despite inflation prints; measures of financial conditions ease over the following quarter

predictions.prediction_text: Concentrated AI-infrastructure spending will create a long-term downside gap if real-economy payoff is smaller than the buildout-driven demand.
predictions.expected_result: Relative underperformance of AI-infrastructure/hyperscaler stocks versus broader market over the medium term (months to years), with increasing downside risk metrics for those names

predictions.prediction_text: When conditions ease due to hidden QE measures, leverage will expand and volatility will compress; conversely, volatility will rise and leverage will be cut when conditions tighten, causing boom-and-bust cycles.
predictions.expected_result: Periods following liquidity-support interventions show lower VIX and higher margin/leverage metrics; subsequent tightening events correspond to marked VIX spikes and deleveraging episodes
